adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `refreshAccessToken` now calls `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then treats the return as a gaxios-style response: `const token = res?.data;`. However, `refreshOAuthTokens` (new in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) returns a raw `fetch(...)` `Response` object in sync mode (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`). A `fetch` `Response` does not have a `.data` property, so `token` becomes `undefined` and `googleCredentials.access_token = token.access_token` will break / never apply the synced token. This mismatch is directly verifiable from the diff.
